verifications.claim: Enterprise Custom shows a 250-seat qualification minimum when the team size is set below that threshold.

verifications.claim: The Request quote control is disabled for Enterprise Custom below its 250-seat minimum.
verifications.evidence: The trace recorded the below-minimum qualification message at 249 seats (step 8), but did not record the Request quote control's disabled/enabled state for Enterprise Custom at that size.

verifications.claim: Selecting a visible catalogue plan reliably changes the selected plan and quote.
verifications.evidence: Attempts to select Enterprise Custom and Team Annual produced no visible state change: Enterprise Annual/Team Monthly remained selected and the quote remained unchanged despite enabled visible Select controls (steps 5-6 and 12-13).

verifications.claim: Catalogue pagination presents distinct consecutive plans, so page 2's first row follows rather than repeats page 1's fourth row.
verifications.evidence: Page 1's fourth row was Team Annual (step 10), and after Next, page 2's first row was also observed as Team Annual (step 15), demonstrating a duplicate instead of the next catalogue plan.

verifications.claim: At 10 seats, selecting Team Monthly displays Team Monthly, 10 seats, and an estimated monthly amount of $180.00.
